evals.prompt: what skills do you have available?
evals.expected_output: A categorized list of all available skills with names and descriptions, plus invocation instructions

assertions.name: lists_many_skills
assertions.description: Response mentions at least 10 distinct skill names

assertions.name: groups_by_category
assertions.description: Response organizes skills into at least 2 named groups or categories

assertions.name: includes_invocation_guidance
assertions.description: Response explains how to invoke a skill (mentions slash commands or /skill-name pattern)

assertions.name: mentions_vercel_family
assertions.description: Response acknowledges the vercel:* family of skills (doesn't silently omit them)

evals.prompt: is there anything that can help me make a slideshow?
evals.expected_output: Direct yes answer identifying the pptx skill with invocation instructions, without dumping the full skill list

assertions.name: identifies_pptx
assertions.description: Response names the `pptx` skill as the answer

assertions.name: explains_relevance
assertions.description: Response explains that pptx = PowerPoint / presentations / slideshows

assertions.name: includes_invocation
assertions.description: Response tells the user how to invoke the skill (/pptx or equivalent)

assertions.name: no_full_dump
assertions.description: Response does NOT dump the entire skills list — stays focused on the match

evals.prompt: find me a skill for generating art or designs
evals.expected_output: Filtered list of relevant art/design skills (canvas-design, algorithmic-art, optionally frontend-design) with brief explanations of each

assertions.name: mentions_canvas_design
assertions.description: Response includes canvas-design as a relevant skill

assertions.name: mentions_algorithmic_art
assertions.description: Response includes algorithmic-art as a relevant skill

assertions.name: excludes_unrelated
assertions.description: Response does NOT include unrelated skills like code-review, deploy, or xlsx

assertions.name: differentiates_skills
assertions.description: Response explains how canvas-design and algorithmic-art differ from each other
